sources.snippet: Network and weights: RIFE v4.17 lite from Practical-RIFE (hzwer, MIT). Weights file flownet_v4.17.lite.pkl from the vs-rife model release (HolyWu, MIT). Converted to ONNX (opset 17, fp32) with tool/export_rife.py in the Tellcue repository.
